cards.label: Battersea
cards.text: The old power station hasn't generated anything since before your parents were your age, and it still hums, very faintly, like a tooth that's been pulled but hasn't told the nerve yet.
You put your hand flat against the brick for exactly as long as feels socially acceptable to touch a decommissioned building, and come away with a faint charge of physics-type static in your palm.
